olivia: Quick DR follow-up: compiling owners for remediation and the rehearsal. Reply with ack + ETA.

dan: Traffic snippet: ./client-sim --clients 5000 --session-header X-Session-ID --targets us-west,eu. Will assert <5% sticky failures.
